versions.changelog:
No changes detected in this release.

- No updates or modifications were made to the skill files or documentation.
- Version remains functionally identical to the previous release.

- Added a new usage scenario ("极兔寄件查运费") for estimating J&T shipping fees, including a comparison with ZTO and tips for e-commerce shipping.
- README.md file introduced to the project.

- Removed all runtime code (jtexpress.py, requirements.txt, security.py); documentation only.
- Updated SKILL.md: added usage scenarios, tags, and clarified description.
- Retained privacy and local persistence documentation for reference.
- No functional endpoints remain; skill is reference-only in this version.

Initial release of J&T Express skill.

- Provides shipment tracking, service-type comparison, outlet lookup, and delivery-time or fee estimation for J&T Express.
- Supports privacy controls and local data persistence when used with the CLI.
- Guides users through shipment tracking, fee/time estimation, and other common tasks.
- Includes clear information about data storage and privacy options.
